items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: Eddie came back and say all right let's go back. She say you all go back I'm talking to John.

ctx.x: much, she gave him a shirt -- I think it cost about $50.00. That's more than he had on! (Laughter). You know, so Lem Davis and I took him to our tailor who was Leeds Tailors in Manhattan. We picked out the materials, told him how to cut it and at that time the one piece back was fashionable, you know. And we dressed him up and boy he looked like someone else.

So one night we were playing and he came up and he said, he stuttered you know, he said Jh - Jh - Jh - John to meet you. I say okay. So I laid my bass down. Went back to the back bar, Billie Holiday is standing there. I didn't recognize her, in fact I don't recall having seen her picture, but I heard her records out here before I ever left here. The first record I recall having heard her sing was "Sun Bonnet Blue and the Yellow Straw Hat." And he says "John Simmons, Billie Holiday," I say Wow! I say I sure have…

She say, you know, I never noticed a bass before, she said "I never heard a bass before," she said I-she just took it for granted that that was something that was supposed to be in the band.
